name: DataDrivenTest
summary: Takes both its data and its expected results from outside the code, so that cases can be added without a programmer.

roles.name: DataDrivenTest
roles.summary: A test whose cases live in a file or a table. Distinct from a parameterized test, which takes arguments a programmer wrote: here the point is that somebody who is not a programmer adds a row — and the cost is that a failure has to be traced back to a row rather than to a line.
